---
title: "`r params$title`"
author: "`r params$author`"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    theme: flatly
    code_folding: hide
params:
  task: NULL
  diag: NULL
  narrative: NULL
  references: NULL
  title: "Event Study Report"
  author: ""
  sections: !r c("exec_summary", "data_methods", "results", "diagnostics", "robustness", "references")
  cross_sectional: NULL
  confidence_level: 0.95
  interactive: TRUE
  advice: NULL
  fig_path: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)
# CR-02: per-format fig.path isolation. output_options= is ignored by
# rmarkdown::render() when output_format is a custom format object; the
# fig.path must be set via knitr global options inside the template so that
# each sequential format render writes figures to a distinct directory and
# avoids file collisions across html/pdf/word/md renders.
if (!is.null(params$fig_path) && nzchar(params$fig_path)) {
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.path = params$fig_path)
}
# VIZ-05/VIZ-07: per-format figure sizing. The single global fig.width=10 /
# fig.height=6 is replaced with dimensions tuned to each output format's page
# geometry. Keyed on the pandoc target so PDF/Word figures fit the printed
# page while HTML stays large. startsWith() is robust to the pandoc suffix
# (e.g. "gfm-yaml_metadata_block").
pandoc_to <- knitr::opts_knit$get("rmarkdown.pandoc.to") %||% "html"
if (startsWith(pandoc_to, "latex")) {
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 4, dpi = 300)
} else if (startsWith(pandoc_to, "docx")) {
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 6, fig.height = 3.7, dpi = 300)
} else if (startsWith(pandoc_to, "gfm")) {
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5, dpi = 150)
} else {
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6, dpi = 96)
}
# VIZ-07: use the ragg raster device for crisper PNG output when available;
# degrade silently to the default device when the optional package is absent.
if (requireNamespace("ragg", quietly = TRUE)) {
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev = "ragg_png")
}
library(EventStudy)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

task     <- params$task
diag     <- params$diag
sections <- params$sections
is_panel <- inherits(task, "PanelEventStudyTask")

# Helper: get per-section heading label from section_sources metadata
.section_label <- function(key) {
  if (!is.null(params$narrative) && !is.null(params$narrative$section_sources)) {
    src <- params$narrative$section_sources[[key]]
    if (identical(src, "ai")) {
      return("*AI-grounded interpretation*")
    }
  }
  "*Automated rule-based interpretation*"
}
```

```{r check-task, results='asis'}
if (is.null(task)) {
  cat("**Error:** No task object provided.\n")
  knitr::knit_exit()
}
```

```{r exec-summary, results='asis', eval="exec_summary" %in% sections}
cat("## Executive Summary\n\n")
cat(.section_label("exec_summary"), "\n\n")
if (!is.null(params$narrative) && nzchar(params$narrative$exec_summary %||% "")) {
  cat(params$narrative$exec_summary, "\n\n")
} else {
  # Offline auto-lead: basic study facts
  if (!is_panel) {
    n_ev <- nrow(task$data_tbl)
    grps <- paste(unique(task$data_tbl$group), collapse = ", ")
    cat(sprintf(
      "This event study analyzes %d event(s) across group(s): %s. ",
      n_ev, grps
    ), "\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("This panel event study uses a difference-in-differences design.\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r data-methods, results='asis', eval="data_methods" %in% sections}
cat("## Data and Methods\n\n")
cat(.section_label("data_methods"), "\n\n")

# Prose lead-in from narrative (always offline/rule-based for data_methods)
if (!is.null(params$narrative) && nzchar(params$narrative$data_methods %||% "")) {
  cat(params$narrative$data_methods, "\n\n")
}

# Deterministic table from task metadata (TMPL-02: never from LLM)
if (!is_panel && !is.null(task$data_tbl)) {
  cat("### Study Overview\n\n")
  n_events  <- nrow(task$data_tbl)
  n_valid   <- if (!is.null(diag)) diag$cross_sectional$n_valid_events else NA_integer_
  grps      <- paste(unique(task$data_tbl$group), collapse = ", ")
  ew_cols   <- c("event_window_start", "event_window_end",
                 "estimation_window_length")
  req_row   <- if ("request" %in% names(task$data_tbl)) task$data_tbl$request[[1]] else NULL

  overview_tbl <- data.frame(
    Item  = c("Events", "Valid (fitted) events", "Groups", "Confidence level"),
    Value = c(
      as.character(n_events),
      if (!is.na(n_valid)) as.character(n_valid) else "N/A",
      grps,
      sprintf("%.0f%%", params$confidence_level * 100)
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  if (!is.null(req_row) && all(ew_cols %in% names(req_row))) {
    overview_tbl <- rbind(overview_tbl, data.frame(
      Item  = c("Event window (start)", "Event window (end)", "Est. window length"),
      Value = c(
        as.character(req_row$event_window_start),
        as.character(req_row$event_window_end),
        as.character(req_row$estimation_window_length)
      ),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  EventStudy:::.report_table(overview_tbl, caption = "Study design parameters",
                col.names = c("Parameter", "Value"))
  cat("\n")

  # Deterministic model diagnostics table from diag (TMPL-02)
  if (!is.null(diag)) {
    cat("### Model Fit Summary\n\n")
    ew_r2    <- diag$estimation_window$r2
    ew_sigma <- diag$estimation_window$sigma
    ew_dof   <- diag$estimation_window$degree_of_freedom
    n_shown  <- diag$meta$n_events_shown
    diag_tbl <- data.frame(
      Metric = c(
        "Events in detail",
        "Mean R-squared",
        "Median R-squared",
        "Mean residual sigma",
        "Mean degrees of freedom"
      ),
      Value  = c(
        as.character(n_shown),
        sprintf("%.4f", mean(ew_r2, na.rm = TRUE)),
        sprintf("%.4f", median(ew_r2, na.rm = TRUE)),
        sprintf("%.5f", mean(ew_sigma, na.rm = TRUE)),
        sprintf("%.1f", mean(ew_dof, na.rm = TRUE))
      ),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    EventStudy:::.report_table(diag_tbl, caption = "Estimation window model fit")
    cat("\n")
  }
}

if (is_panel && !is.null(task$results)) {
  cat("### Panel Study Design\n\n")
  cat(sprintf("**Method:** %s\n\n", task$results$method))
}
```

```{r results, results='asis', eval="results" %in% sections}
cat("## Results\n\n")
cat(.section_label("results"), "\n\n")

# Narrative prose lead-in (interpretive; may be LLM or offline)
if (!is.null(params$narrative) && nzchar(params$narrative$results %||% "")) {
  cat(params$narrative$results, "\n\n")
}

# Deterministic AR/CAR/AAR/CAAR tables from task (TMPL-02: not from narrative)
if (!is_panel && !is.null(task$data_tbl)) {

  # AR/CAR table from task columns
  has_art  <- "ART"  %in% names(task$data_tbl)
  has_cart <- "CART" %in% names(task$data_tbl)

  if (has_art || has_cart) {
    cat("### Abnormal Return Summary\n\n")
    n_ev <- nrow(task$data_tbl)
    rows <- list()
    for (i in seq_len(n_ev)) {
      ev_id   <- task$data_tbl$event_id[[i]]
      firm    <- task$data_tbl$firm_symbol[[i]]
      ar_t_v  <- NA_real_
      car_t_v <- NA_real_
      car_v   <- NA_real_
      if (has_art) {
        art_tbl <- task$data_tbl$ART[[i]]
        if (!is.null(art_tbl) && "ar_t" %in% names(art_tbl) && nrow(art_tbl) > 0) {
          ar_t_v <- tail(art_tbl$ar_t, 1L)
        }
      }
      if (has_cart) {
        cart_tbl <- task$data_tbl$CART[[i]]
        if (!is.null(cart_tbl) && nrow(cart_tbl) > 0) {
          if ("car_t" %in% names(cart_tbl)) car_t_v <- tail(cart_tbl$car_t, 1L)
          if ("car"   %in% names(cart_tbl)) car_v   <- tail(cart_tbl$car,   1L)
        }
      }
      rows[[i]] <- data.frame(
        Event    = as.character(ev_id),
        Firm     = as.character(firm),
        AR_t     = if (!is.na(ar_t_v))  round(ar_t_v,  4) else NA_real_,
        CAR_t    = if (!is.na(car_t_v)) round(car_t_v, 4) else NA_real_,
        Final_CAR = if (!is.na(car_v))  round(car_v,   4) else NA_real_,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
    res_tbl <- do.call(rbind, rows)
    EventStudy:::.report_table(res_tbl,
                  caption = "Abnormal and cumulative abnormal returns",
                  col.names = c("Event", "Firm", "AR t-stat",
                                "CAR t-stat", "Final CAR"))
    cat("\n")
  }

  cat("### Abnormal Returns Plot\n\n")
}
```

}

```{r aar-caar, results='asis', eval="results" %in% sections && !is_panel}
# AAR/CAAR multi-event tables
if (!is_panel && !is.null(task$aar_caar_tbl)) {
  cat("### Multi-Event Test Statistics (AAR/CAAR)\n\n")
  stat_names <- setdiff(names(task$aar_caar_tbl), c("group", "data", "model"))
  for (sn in stat_names) {
    cat(sprintf("\n#### %s\n\n", sn))
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(task$aar_caar_tbl))) {
      grp      <- task$aar_caar_tbl$group[i]
      stat_tbl <- task$aar_caar_tbl[[sn]][[i]]
      cat(sprintf("**Group: %s**\n\n", grp))
      EventStudy:::.report_table(stat_tbl, digits = 4L)
      cat("\n")
    }
  }
}
```

```{r diagnostics, results='asis', eval="diagnostics" %in% sections && !is_panel}
cat("## Diagnostics\n\n")

if (!is.null(diag)) {
  # Estimation window diagnostics table
  cat("### Estimation Window Diagnostics\n\n")
  ew  <- diag$estimation_window
  cs  <- diag$cross_sectional
  n   <- diag$meta$n_events_shown
  ev_ids <- diag$meta$event_ids_shown

  diag_tbl <- data.frame(
    Event      = as.character(ev_ids),
    R2         = round(ew$r2, 4),
    Sigma      = round(ew$sigma, 5),
    DoF        = round(ew$degree_of_freedom, 0),
    Shapiro_p  = round(ew$shapiro_p, 4),
    DW_stat    = round(ew$dw_stat, 4),
    LjungBox_p = round(ew$ljung_box_p, 4),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  EventStudy:::.report_table(diag_tbl,
                caption = "Per-event estimation-window diagnostics",
                col.names = c("Event", "R-sq", "Sigma", "DoF",
                              "Shapiro p", "DW stat", "LjungBox p"),
                digits = 4L)
  cat("\n")

  # Cross-sectional diagnostics
  cat("### Cross-Sectional Summary\n\n")
  cs_tbl <- data.frame(
    Metric = c("Total events", "Valid (fitted) events",
               "CAR IQR", "CAR SD",
               "Overlap pairs", "Any overlap"),
    Value  = c(
      as.character(cs$n_events),
      as.character(cs$n_valid_events),
      if (!is.na(cs$car_iqr)) sprintf("%.6f", cs$car_iqr) else "N/A",
      if (!is.na(cs$car_sd))  sprintf("%.6f", cs$car_sd)  else "N/A",
      if (!is.na(cs$n_overlap_pairs)) as.character(cs$n_overlap_pairs) else "N/A",
      if (!is.na(cs$any_overlap))     as.character(cs$any_overlap) else "N/A"
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  EventStudy:::.report_table(cs_tbl, caption = "Cross-sectional diagnostics",
                col.names = c("Diagnostic", "Value"))
  cat("\n")

  cat("### Residual Sigma Distribution\n\n")
} else if ("model" %in% names(task$data_tbl)) {
  # Fallback if diag was not pre-computed (backward compat)
  cat("### Model Diagnostics\n\n")
  diag_data <- task$data_tbl %>%
    mutate(
      sigma = purrr::map_dbl(model, ~{
        s <- .x$statistics$sigma
        if (is.null(s)) NA_real_ else s
      }),
      r2 = purrr::map_dbl(model, ~{
        r2_val <- .x$statistics$r2
        if (is.null(r2_val)) NA_real_ else r2_val
      }),
      dof = purrr::map_dbl(model, ~{
        d <- .x$statistics$degree_of_freedom
        if (is.null(d)) NA_real_ else d
      }),
      autocorr = purrr::map_dbl(model, ~{
        ac <- .x$statistics$first_order_auto_correlation
        if (is.null(ac)) NA_real_ else ac
      })
    ) %>%
    select(event_id, firm_symbol, sigma, r2, dof, autocorr)

  EventStudy:::.report_table(diag_data, caption = "Model Diagnostics by Event",
                digits = 4L)
}
```

```{r sigma-hist, fig.cap="Distribution of estimation-window residual sigma across events.", eval="diagnostics" %in% sections && !is_panel}
# Residual sigma distribution (plot with HTML/non-HTML switch)
if (!is.null(diag)) {
  tryCatch({
    ew <- diag$estimation_window
    sigma_df <- data.frame(sigma = ew$sigma[!is.na(ew$sigma)])
    if (nrow(sigma_df) > 0) {
      p <- ggplot(sigma_df, aes(x = sigma)) +
        geom_histogram(bins = 15, fill = es_colours[["primary"]], alpha = 0.7) +
        labs(x = "Residual Sigma", y = "Count",
             title = "Distribution of Residual Sigma") +
        theme_minimal()
      if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
        if (requireNamespace("plotly", quietly = TRUE)) {
          print(plotly::ggplotly(p))
        } else {
          print(p)
        }
      } else {
        print(p)
      }
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Could not generate sigma distribution plot.")
  })
}
```

```{r robustness, results='asis', eval="robustness" %in% sections}
cat("## Robustness and Caveats\n\n")
cat(.section_label("robustness"), "\n\n")
if (!is.null(params$narrative) && nzchar(params$narrative$robustness %||% "")) {
  # Narrative for this section already contains JOINT_HYPOTHESIS_CAVEAT
  # appended by assemble_report_narrative() (NARR-05).
  cat(params$narrative$robustness, "\n\n")
} else {
  # Offline fallback: emit the joint-hypothesis caveat directly (NARR-05)
  cat(
    "Note: statistical significance of abnormal returns is a joint test of ",
    "the event effect and the correctness of the return model. ",
    "Rejection of the null may reflect model misspecification rather than a ",
    "true event effect (MacKinlay 1997).\n\n"
  )
}
```

```{r advice-section, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$advice) && inherits(params$advice, "Advice")}
cat("\n## AI Advisor Interpretation\n\n")
advice <- params$advice
cat(sprintf("*Source: %s | Deterministic: %s*\n\n",
            advice$source,
            advice$is_deterministic))

if (nzchar(advice$interpretation %||% "")) {
  cat("### Interpretation\n\n")
  cat(advice$interpretation, "\n\n")
}

if (length(advice$recommendations) > 0L) {
  cat("### Recommendations\n\n")
  for (i in seq_along(advice$recommendations)) {
    r <- advice$recommendations[[i]]
    cat(sprintf("**%d. %s**\n\n", i, r$action %||% ""))
    if (nzchar(r$rationale %||% "")) cat(r$rationale, "\n\n")
    if (nzchar(r$expected_effect %||% "")) {
      cat("*Expected effect:*", r$expected_effect, "\n\n")
    }
  }
}

if (length(advice$caveats) > 0L) {
  cat("### Caveats\n\n")
  for (cv in advice$caveats) cat("-", cv, "\n")
  cat("\n")
}
```

```{r narrative-section, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$narrative)}
# REPORT-03 (Phase 17): backward-compat chunk -- retained for callers
# that pass narrative= directly without using the fixed section chunks above.
# This chunk only renders when narrative is non-NULL AND the new fixed-section
# chunks were NOT active (i.e., none of the six new keys is in sections).
new_keys <- c("exec_summary", "data_methods", "results",
              "diagnostics", "robustness", "references")
if (!any(new_keys %in% sections)) {
  narrative <- params$narrative
  if (!is.null(narrative) && is.list(narrative)) {
    cat("\n## AI/Offline Narrative\n\n")
    if (nzchar(narrative$exec_summary %||% "")) {
      cat("### Executive Summary\n\n")
      cat(narrative$exec_summary, "\n\n")
    }
    if (nzchar(narrative$data_methods %||% "")) {
      cat("### Data & Methods\n\n")
      cat(narrative$data_methods, "\n\n")
    }
    if (nzchar(narrative$results %||% "")) {
      cat("### Results\n\n")
      cat(narrative$results, "\n\n")
    }
    if (nzchar(narrative$robustness %||% "")) {
      cat("### Robustness & Caveats\n\n")
      cat(narrative$robustness, "\n\n")
    }
  }
}
```

```{r references, results='asis', eval="references" %in% sections}
refs <- params$references
if (!is.null(refs) && length(refs) > 0L) {
  cat("## References\n\n")
  for (ref in refs) {
    author <- ref$author %||% "Unknown"
    year   <- ref$year   %||% ""
    key    <- ref$key    %||% ""
    venue  <- ref$venue  %||% ""
    if (nzchar(venue)) {
      cat(sprintf("- %s (%s). *%s.*\n", author, year, venue))
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("- %s (%s).\n", author, year))
    }
  }
  cat("\n")
}
```
